name: badge
title: Badge
description: A small chip for a status, a category or a count.
use: A label that is read and not operated: a status, a category, a version, a count. Neutral badges carry most labels; a tone appears only with a status, beside words that say the same thing, and badge-category only with the name of a category. A compound badge holds a smaller badge and a short message in one capsule, such as an announcement over a hero.

instead.when: It is a filter that can be chosen or a value that can be removed
The status is a message about the page, with a sentence to read
The pill names a value that can be removed or chosen, with a picture or a count

classes.name: badge-outline
classes.description: A contour only, with no fill

classes.name: badge-raised
classes.description: A small raised sheet, for a badge that sits on a busy surface

classes.name: badge-category
classes.description: The surface, text and line of the category set by a category-<name> class on it or around it; with badge-dot the dot is the category's mark. Neutral without a category. Never with a status tone

classes.name: badge-info
classes.description: A wash of the info hue

classes.name: badge-success
classes.description: A wash of the success hue

classes.name: badge-warning
classes.description: A wash of the warning hue

classes.name: badge-danger
classes.description: A wash of the danger hue

classes.name: badge-dot
classes.description: A leading 6px dot in the badge's tone

classes.name: badge-live
classes.description: With badge-dot: the dot sends out a ring, for something happening now. With reduced motion it is a plain dot

classes.name: badge-corner
classes.description: A count on the corner of its nearest positioned parent, cut out by a ring of the surface it sits on. Describe the count in the parent's accessible name

classes.name: badge-compound
classes.description: A 28px capsule that holds a badge-addon and a message; its corner is the addon's plus the inset. As a link, the whole capsule is one target

classes.name: badge-label
classes.description: Words that may be long: they shrink and end in an ellipsis while a picture, a dot or a count keeps its size

classes.name: badge-media
classes.description: A round picture at the start, the badge's height less two insets: holds an avatar or an icon, which it sizes

classes.name: badge-addon
classes.description: The smaller raised badge inside a badge-compound, at its start or its end; its corner is the outer corner less the inset

properties.name: --badge-ring
properties.description: Color of the ring around a badge-corner. It is not declared: it falls back to --surface-color, then to --color-surface-base

properties.name: --badge-inset
properties.description: How far a badge-media or a badge-addon stands in from the badge's edge
